In this role, you'll shape how our products are positioned, sold, and adopted—from defining compelling product narratives to enabling Sales and partnering with Growth and Marketing on launches. This is a role for someone who enjoys sitting at the intersection of Product and commercial teams, translating customer insight into positioning, propositions, and go-to-market strategies that help more businesses choose Monzo.

You'll define a one-year Product Marketing strategy for a major area of Business Banking, connecting customer insight, market opportunity, and commercial priorities into a clear direction for the product area, rather than one individual product, with measurable business outcomes.

• Develop differentiated positioning & messaging: You'll create compelling positioning, messaging, and value propositions that differentiate Monzo in the market and resonate with different customer segments. You'll build messaging frameworks that Product, Sales, Integrated Marketing, and broader marketing teams use consistently across launches and customer journeys.

• Drive competitive intelligence and market insights: You’ll build and maintain the market view for your product area. title: Director Indirect Sales & Partnerships (x/f/m)
description:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Wir suchen Dich als Director Indirect Sales & Partnerships (x/f/m) als Unterstützung für unser Team in Berlin.

Als Director Indirect Sales & Partnerships (x/f/m) übernimmst Du eine zentrale strategische Führungsrolle: Du transformierst Doctolibs Go-to-Market-Ansatz in Deutschland – und baust einen skalierbaren, quoten-gesteuerten indirekten Vertriebskanal mit IT-Systemhäusern als Kern auf. Du führst ein Team von fünf Mitarbeitenden und baust ein Netzwerk von 50–60 stabilen IT-Systempartnern auf, die gemeinsam mit Doctolib flächendeckend die Digitalisierung des deutschen Gesundheitswesens vorantreiben. Mit Deiner Arbeit schaffst Du einen wachsenden Umsatzpfeiler, der das Direktvertriebsvolumen langfristig ergänzt – und prägst damit maßgeblich die strategische Ausrichtung von Doctolib Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du entwickelst und skalierst einen leistungsstarken indirekten Vertriebskanal mit ausgewählten Top-IT-Systemhäusern (ITSPs) in ganz Deutschland und stellst damit eine flächendeckende regionale Abdeckung sicher

• Du transformierst das bestehende Geschäftsmodell von einem Direktvertriebsmodell zu einem echten indirekten Vertriebskanal mit klaren Quoten, strukturiertem Forecasting und datengetriebenem Performance-Steering

• Du verhandelst und schließt strategische Partnerschaften mit führenden IT-Dienstleistern – inklusive kommerzieller Konstrukte, Priorisierung von Integrationen und konkreter Rollout-Pläne und bist damit mehrere Tage im Monat vor Ort bei den potentiellen Partnern

• Du konzipierst skalierbare Partner-Management-Frameworks, differenzierte Anreizstrukturen und effiziente operative Prozesse für Dein Team

• Du führst, entwickelst und inspirierst ein Team von rund 5 FTEs und baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf Geschäftsführerebene mit den Managing Directors der Systemhauspartner auf

• Du arbeitest eng mit den deutschen Führungsteams aus Sales, Product, Marketing und Tech zusammen und wirkst als Mitglied des German Leadership Teams aktiv an der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von Doctolib Deutschland mit

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

• Mehr als 10 Jahre nachgewiesene Senior-Führungserfahrung im Aufbau und der Skalierung von indirekten Vertriebskanälen und Partnerkanälen – idealerweise in B2B SaaS, Enterprise Software, IT-Lösungen (Cloud Services) oder im IT-Systemhaus-Umfeld

• Tiefgreifende Expertise in der Zusammenarbeit mit IT-Systemhäusern (ITSPs), einschließlich der Gestaltung von Partneranreizprogrammen, kommerziellen Vertragsstrukturen und Deployment-Plänen

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Transformation von Vertriebsorganisationen, im Change Management sowie im Aufbau und der Führung von leistungsstarken Sales- und Partnerteams

• Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, Begeisterung für den Aufbau von Beziehungen von Grund auf sowie unternehmerisches Denken und hohe Eigeninitiative

• Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt ein, um Vertriebsprozesse zu optimieren, Partnerperformance datenbasiert zu steuern und Dein Team in der Nutzung neuer Technologien weiterzuentwickeln

• Du arbeitest datengetrieben, entwirfst skalierbare Prozesse und iterierst schnell auf Basis von Ergebnissen

• Du bist eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit: Du rekrutierst, coachst und entwickelst Dein Team und schaffst eine leistungsorientierte, motivierende Teamkultur

• Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch auf C1-Niveau

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

• Vorerfahrung im Healthcare- oder Medical-Software-Sektor

• nachgewiesene MRR-Skalierung in einem Multi-Produkt-SaaS-Umfeld

• Erfahrung im Account Management mit kleinen und mittelständischen Unternehmen 

Was wir Dir bieten

• 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

• Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten

• Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)

• Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)

• Einen Firmenwagen

• Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält

• Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner

• Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine

• Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

• Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

Der Interviewprozess

• Interview mit dem Hiring Manager (1 Std.)

• Business Interview (1 Std.)

• Peer Interview (1 Std.)

• Case Study (1,5 Std.)

• Referenzprüfungen

Job Details

• Festanstellung

• Berlin

• Hybride Arbeitsweise (3 Tage Office/Woche)

• Ab sofort

title: Lead Marketing Data Analyst (x/f/m)
description:
Vos missions

Nous recherchons un(e) Lead Marketing Data Analyst pour rejoindre l'équipe B2B Performance Marketing. En tant que Lead Marketing Data Analyst, vous êtes la référence analytique de l'équipe sur la performance d'acquisition, l'attribution et la valeur client. 

Vous transformez des données cross-canal complexes en concepts clairs et en recommandations concrètes qui influencent directement les décisions d'investissement, de ciblage et de croissance de l'équipe. Vous êtes le socle data sur lequel s'appuient le spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI et le Digital Analyst : vous garantissez que la bonne donnée est disponible, fiable et exploitable par tous.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les Data Product Managers pour trouver les bonnes solutions et aligner les équipes Data sur des définitions communes, des métriques partagées et une structuration cohérente de la donnée. Vous êtes également le partenaire des Sales Operations (équipe SCOPS) pour construire l'infrastructure de “lead scoring” qui connecte Marketing et Sales.

Vous évoluez dans un environnement AI-first : les modèles ML, les pipelines automatisés et l'analyse assistée par IA feront partie de votre quotidien.

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

1. Attribution, parcours de conversion & incrémentalité (30%)

• Piloter le modèle d'attribution multi-touch de l'équipe entre SEO, acquisition payante et CRM

• Construire et maintenir une vue unifiée des parcours de conversion, exploitable depuis le data warehouse

• Définir et documenter les définitions de conversion communes sur lesquelles toute l'équipe s'aligne

• Accompagner les équipes Paid et CRM dans la mesure de leur impact (tests d'incrémentalité, Marketing Mix Modeling, Causal Impact…)

• Travailler avec les Data Product Managers pour s'assurer que les modèles de données et les flux associés sont correctement structurés et maintenus

2. LTV/SAC, analyses de cohortes & reporting à la Direction (25%)

• Suivre la LTV et le SAC par canal d'acquisition, segment et cohorte

• Construire et maintenir les courbes de rétention par cohorte (J7, J30, J90) et identifier les moments de churn

• Déterminer quelles sources d'acquisition et quels segments génèrent la plus forte valeur à long terme

• Développer des modèles de prévision en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Data et Finance

• Produire le reporting LTV/SAC mensuel qui guide les décisions d'allocation budgétaire et préparer les synthèses de performance partagées avec la Direction

3. Scoring des leads & partenariat avec les équipes commerciales (20%)

• Concevoir et déployer un modèle de scoring des leads basé sur le machine learning avec l'équipe SCOPS, pour déterminer quels leads sont transmis aux commerciaux et lesquels sont nurturés en CRM

• Traduire les données comportementales et d'engagement en un modèle de scoring activable dans le CRM, en coordination avec le spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI 

• Faire évoluer le modèle au fil des nouvelles données et des retours des équipes commerciales

4. Disponibilité de la donnée & support de l'équipe (15%)

• Être le partenaire data du spécialiste CRM Tooling & AI et du Digital Analyst : garantir que la donnée dont ils ont besoin est disponible, bien documentée et fiable

• Traduire leurs besoins en exigences structurées pour les Data Product Managers

• Identifier les problèmes de qualité de données en amont et les suivre jusqu'à leur résolution

• Être le lien entre l'équipe Performance Marketing et l'organisation Data

5. Tableaux de bord opérationnels & suivi de la performance (10%)

• Piloter les tableaux de bord de performance globale de l'équipe : acquisition, attribution, LTV/SAC et contribution par canal (suivi quotidien, pilotage hebdomadaire, vue mensuelle pour la direction)

• Mettre en place une détection automatique des anomalies, des synthèses narratives générées par IA et des analyses exploratoires assistées pour libérer du temps sur des travaux analytiques à plus forte valeur ajoutée

Les qualités attendues pour ce poste

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

• Justifiez de 7 à 10 ans d'expérience en analytics marketing, growth analytics ou business analytics idéalement dans des scale-ups B2B SaaS

• Avez l'habitude de piloter un travail analytique de bout en bout, du modèle de données à la présentation à la Direction

• Maîtrisez les requêtes SQL de manière autonome au quotidien et avez travaillé directement avec BigQuery ou équivalent

• Avez une expérience concrète en attribution et/ou en incrémentalité : vous avez construit ou piloté un modèle d'attribution multi-touch, mené des tests d'incrémentalité (user-based, geolift) ou travaillé sur du Marketing Mix Modeling

• Avez une expérience en optimisation du funnel marketing :

• Stratégie d'acquisition & d'activation

• Modélisation de la LTV / SAC dans un contexte SaaS ou par abonnement : avoir réalisé des analyses LTV et SAC basées sur des cohortes, utilisées pour orienter l'allocation budgétaire ou des décisions stratégiques.

• Définition des KPIs et cadre de référence (MQLs, SQLs, Leads...)

• Expérience avec des outils de visualisation de données : Amplitude, Tableau, Looker, Metabase…

• Maîtrisez l'anglais et le français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral

Ce serait fantastique si vous aviez aussi :

• Des compétences en Python ou R pour la modélisation statistique avancée et le développement de modèles de machine learning

• Une connaissance des modèles de croissance tirés par le produit (product-led growth) et de la façon dont les données d'usage alimentent la mesure marketing

title: Lead Product Manager - Patient Data Collection (x/f/m)
description:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join the Patient Profile team in the Patient domain.

Your mission will be to make the patient health record complete, accurate and current enough that everything else we build can act on it, the health recommendations, care plans and assistant experiences that help people take their health into their own hands. You will work in a feature team developing the Patient Health Record, health trackers, patient account and online identity, contributing directly to the quality of the medical support we provide to both patients and practitioners. 

A patient record is built from four channels: what patients enter themselves, what they share when preparing a consultation, what we retrieve from health professionals' systems, and what they connect from third-party sources such as Apple Health, Google Health Connect and national health record services. Three of those channels belong to teams you will not manage. You will own the outcome across all four, the most leveraged place to sit in a health platform, and only reachable through other people.

You will also work inside a hard regulatory perimeter: health data, GDPR, consent by design. 

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Own the end-to-end patient data collection programme across every channel a patient record is built from, and be accountable for the result across all four

• Define what a useful record actually means for the teams that depend on it, make that definition measurable, and instrument it rather than inheriting a dashboard

• Partner with the channel-owning teams inside and outside the group: set the inter-team contracts, agree how each channel contributes, and arbitrate collection priorities

• Own record quality and freshness rather than volume, alongside health data storage consent, patient account and online identity

• Ship the layers that serve this data to the rest of the product: the patient feature store, the patient context service and the Patient Health Record feature

• Lead the Patient Profile team's roadmap and delivery, from PHR (patient health record) and trackers through to the feature store and context service

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

• You have owned a coverage, completeness or data quality metric as your primary objective, and can say what it went from, to what, and over how long

• You have worked at millions-of-records scale

• You have moved that metric through teams that did not report to you, setting interfaces, contracts and SLAs with partner teams

• You have shipped under a hard regulatory or consent constraint, in health, finance or identity, with privacy and consent by design

• You have real technical depth: you have owned a data platform component as a product, a feature store, a context or profile service, or an identity layer. 

• You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

• You have had a data quality problem surface only once it reached a downstream consumer, and you changed how you worked because of it

• You have built a completeness or quality definition and made an organisation adopt it

• You have worked on interoperability, health data standards, or identity and account models

What we offer

• Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

• 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

• Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

• Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

• Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

• A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

• 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

• ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

• For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

• Relocation support in case of international mobility

• Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

• Talent Acquisition Interview (Maxime Balme)

• Hiring Manager Interview (Léo Lanzarotti) 

• Case Study with Product Panel

• Behavioral Interview with peers, including at least one channel-owning team

• At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

• Permanent position

• Full-time

• Levallois-Perret, France

• Hybrid work setup (2 remote days per week)

• Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: Germany l France l Italy l Netherlands. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

Doctolib sucht Dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Praktikant:in im Bereich Product Marketing für unseren Standort in Berlin.

• 28 Urlaubstage im Jahr (anteilig auf Deine Arbeitszeiten berechnet)

• Ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell, das hybrides- und Office-basiertes Arbeiten ermöglicht

title: Senior Product Manager - Product Led Growth- Paris (x/f/m)

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Product team at Doctolib.

Your mission: scale Doctolib's acquisition engine into a measurable, lower-cost growth driver across France, Germany and Italy. You will own the end-to-end product-led and marketing-led growth funnel, from freemium offer design to subscription and in-product upsell, contributing directly to growing ARR while bringing the cost to acquire new practitioners down.

• Own Doctolib freemium offer: define what is free, metered, or demo-only, and design the conversion paths that move practitioners to a paid plan

• Define acquisition-side packaging: offer catalogue, eligibility rules, and contract signature flows across France, Germany and Italy

• Lead marketing-led growth initiatives, including lead generation, B2B website conversion, and lifecycle marketing, connecting them to the core product funnel

• You have owned a PLG conversion, ARR or CAC metric as your primary objective in B2B SaaS at scale, and can quantify what it moved, from what baseline, over what period

• You have scaled product-led growth alongside a sales motion, and can explain how you chose between autonomous conversion and handing sales a warm lead, offer by offer

• You have solid product judgement on pricing, packaging, eligibility and freemium boundaries, and can work within a regulated environment with consent and country-specific constraints in mind

• You set direction for teams you do not manage and move a metric across a cross-functional chain

• You are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

• Have owned both product-led and marketing-led growth, connecting lifecycle, attribution or lead scoring to the product funnel

• Have worked across multiple countries with different pricing or packaging constraints

• Have experience in a regulated or healthcare context

• 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

• ParentCare Program: full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

• Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

• For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

• Relocation support in case of international mobility

• Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

• Hiring Manager Interview (Louis Durteste)

title: Lead Product Manager, DeFi
description:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. We are looking for a Lead Product Manager, DeFi to build Bitpanda’s DeFi ecosystem from the ground up, creating the world’s premier Euro-denominated DeFi ecosystem while making it safe, accessible, and intuitive for our customers. 

The first use case is crypto-backed borrowing and lending in the Bitpanda app, with an eye to then build more sophisticated products and use cases leveraging tokenized commodities, securities, funds, and structured products. You’ll decide which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, and work collaboratively to bring DeFi to Bitpanda customers in a way that feels as simple as the app they already trust. You'll work in a small, senior team with our smart contract engineers and Bitpanda's Legal, Compliance and Risk teams, as an individual contributor reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

What you’ll do 

• Design and run the lending markets: set loan-to-value and liquidation thresholds, interest rate curves, caps, and oracles, while also owning monitoring and incident playbooks.

• Bring liquidity and users to permissioned markets and assets: set supply targets, bring in euro liquidity from stablecoin issuers, institutional lenders, curated vaults and market makers, and work out how verified customers reach these markets, without paying for volume.

• Make sure the right DeFi infrastructure is in place, particularly for permissioned tokenized assets: DEX liquidity deep enough for swaps and liquidations, liquidators, oracles and the other building blocks the markets depend on.

• Shape what customers see, sign, and own in the Bitpanda app, including how liquidation and risk are explained, and measure real use: borrowers who come back, bad debt and revenue, not total value locked alone.

• Recommend which protocols and partners come to Vision Chain, backed by a business case, and work with Legal, Compliance and Risk from day one on EU consumer credit rules and MiCA.

Who you are 

• 6+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3+ years focused specifically on building and scaling DeFi or crypto products.

• You know lending markets in depth: collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models, oracles and how they fail, curation and bad debt. You're at home with the EVM and can read Solidity smart contract code well enough to question engineers about it.

• Demonstrated experience bringing DeFi applications into regulated consumer products and successfully bridging the gap between decentralized and centralized finance.

• Ability to lead through influence, build clear business cases, and write excellent documentation in English. This includes a strong working knowledge of EU crypto regulations (e.g., MiCA) to effectively partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance teams.

• Nice to haves: 

• hands-on experience scaling onchain ecosystem liquidity from scratch

• knowledge of and/or work experience in traditional financial markets

** This position is available remotely in the EU.

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

 .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

We simplify wealth creation. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Your mission

Bitpanda serves millions of investors across Europe, and we're bringing regulated finance onchain with Vision Chain, our own OP Stack L2 blockchain. As the first product marketer in Web3, you'll own how the chain and every Web3 product built on it is explained, launched and sold: to Bitpanda's customers, and to the financial institutions and developers who build with us.

You will hold full autonomy over go-to-market, combining strategic vision with hands-on campaign execution. You own the story, the launch plan and how we measure success. By bridging our Product, Marketing, and Commercial teams, you will tackle the industry's greatest challenge: converting complex DeFi mechanics, applied to tokenized financial instruments, into accessible financial products for the mass market. You'll use AI tools daily for research, drafting and analysis, and build the playbooks a growing team will use. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Web3 Product.

What you’ll do

• Positioning: Write the positioning and messaging for each Web3 product, for retail customers, institutions, and partners. You will cover Vision Chain, Vision Wallet, Tokenization, DeFi products in the Bitpanda app, and any future Web3 product verticals.

• Launches: Run the Web3 launch calendar, including partner and ecosystem launches on Vision Chain, and brief central marketing, CRM, in-app, localization and PR so every launch lands on time.

• Campaigns: Plan and write campaigns for Bitpanda customers across email, push, in-app and social that help everyday investors understand what tokenized and onchain products offer and what the risks are.

• Institutions and partners: Build the positioning and sales material business development uses with banks, asset managers and partners, and plan joint announcements and case studies.

• Compliance and results: Work with Legal and Compliance from the first draft so every message is clear, fair and accurate. Set a success measure before each launch, and report adoption, retention and revenue with our data team.

Who you are

• Regulated product marketer: Typically 6+ years in product marketing, including time in a regulated financial business or a crypto firm working under MiCA. You know how MiCA, MiFID and EU consumer credit rules shape what you can say. German is a plus.

• Crypto fluent: You've launched crypto or investing products and can explain wallets, L2 networks, stablecoins and tokenized assets in plain language. Experience with tokenization, real-world assets or institutional buyers is a strong plus.

• Partners and sales: You've run partner launches or built material that sales or business development teams use.

• Hands-on builder: You write copy and run launches through teams you don't manage, and you've built a marketing process from scratch before.

• Data-led and AI-fluent: You use AI tools to work faster and check every claim before it ships. You set measures before launch and read activation and retention, not just reach.

** This position is available remotely in the EU or hybrid in one of our 4 hubs.

Paid Search at GetYourGuide sits at the intersection of back-end automation and data products. Your job is to shape that portfolio: set the strategy, define the roadmap, and partner with engineering to ship it.

You'll work closely with the Paid Search Tech engineering team, the Growth Data Product team, and the Paid Search Marketing team, who are both your closest partners and your primary internal customers. If you want to shape the future of paid customer acquisition with us, read on.

Your mission

• Ownership: You are skilled at laying out your team's strategy, setting goals, and following through — owning the outcomes of your team's work end to end.

title: Lead Product Manager, User Platform
description:
Change the way the world travels

GetYourGuide is the globally leading marketplace for unforgettable travel experiences. Travelers use GetYourGuide to discover the best things to do in a destination. Since its founding in 2009, people from all over the world have booked more than 150 million tours, activities, and attraction tickets through GetYourGuide. Powered by a global team of over 1000 travel experts and technologists, we are headquartered in Berlin and have 17 local offices around the world. Visit our careers website to learn more.

Team mission

GetYourGuide knows a great deal about every traveler, and almost none of it is usable today. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions sit in separate systems, in different shapes, so every team that wants to act on what we know rebuilds its own partial version of it. The User Platform team is building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable and predictive understanding that every team can build on. We start with travelers, because that is where the leverage is, and the layer is designed to extend to our other users over time.

Your mission

As a Lead Product Manager, you will own the vision and strategy for a new platform at GetYourGuide, and you will be the first product manager on the team that builds it. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist and an analyst, you will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero to one: the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable are all still to be designed.

The work is equal parts product craft and demand creation. Our consumers are other teams: search and ranking, lifecycle and paid channels, customer care, and the traveler experience itself. Their need is real and widely felt, but they struggle to define what would really solve their problems.

We are looking for a product leader who is fluent in data and machine learning without needing to be a data scientist, who is comfortable when the scope of a domain is still being drawn, and who wants to build the foundation that personalization at GetYourGuide will run on for years.

What You'll Do 

• Ownership: Develop and own a 12+ month vision and strategy for the traveler context domain, define how we win in it, and take full responsibility for the outcomes. Identify where the non-incremental impact sits and sequence the roadmap to reach it.

• Ambiguity: Operate in a domain that is being defined as you build it. Break an open-ended platform problem into a phased, coherent plan, and make confident calls with incomplete information.

• Prioritization: Choose the few use cases that prove the platform, and be explicit about what we will not build. Balance the depth a single consumer wants against the breadth the platform needs, and sequence to maximise learning.

• Collaboration: Build trust with consuming teams across Growth, Retention, Search, Care and Supply, and negotiate the line between what we own and what they own. Proactively manage the dependencies and handoffs that keep the strategy executable.

• Communication and adoption: Make the platform legible to the rest of the company, from engineers to executives. Create demand where none exists yet by showing teams what becomes possible, then convert that into committed adoption.

• Technical fluency: Set the technical bar for the team and work credibly with data scientists and engineers on identity resolution, feature and embedding design, and serving architecture. Bring a clear point of view on when a heuristic beats a model, and on build versus buy versus partner.

• Experimentation: Validate the layer with real consumers and real traffic. Design the tests that show a shared representation outperforms the local copies teams build today.

• Leadership: Represent the interests of our users and our internal consumers at every level of the organization. Act with openness and transparency with your team, your peers and executive leadership, and coach others on the craft of building platform products

Your toolkit

• 6+ years of professional experience in product management, including at least 2 years at Lead level or with equivalent scope, and meaningful time spent on data, machine learning or platform products

• Demonstrated ownership of a product area whose users are other teams, such as an internal platform, an API or a data product, including strategy, KPI definition, goal setting and adoption, not only delivery

• Strong data literacy: comfortable querying and interpreting large datasets, designing experiments, and working day to day with data scientists and analysts

• A working understanding of the machine learning lifecycle and how it differs from software delivery, plus the judgment to know when analytics and good heuristics are the better answer

• A track record of building alignment across a large and varied set of stakeholders, including senior leadership, in a way that is consistent with our Guiding Principles

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Bonus: experience with customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation or personalization systems

• Bonus: experience putting LLMs into production

• Bonus: experience in a marketplace or another two-sided platform

• Bonus: an engineering or analytics background

title: Creative Strategy Lead, New Social Growth Platforms (all genders)
description:
The role

Meta is our core social channel, but the next leg of growth depends on what's around it. The 2026 ambition is clear: scale TikTok into our #2 social channel on incrementality-steered investment, and prove Pinterest, Snap, and other emerging platforms on the same evidence bar.

This role owns that diversification agenda end-to-end. You're the in-house expert on TikTok — its algorithm, Spark Ads, TikTok Creative Exchange, and the 2–3 day creative fatigue window that punishes slow teams. You also drive structured pilots on Pinterest and Snap: technical setup, account architecture, creative strategy tailored to each platform, and the incrementality tests that decide whether we scale or shut down. You don't run media for these channels in BAU mode — you build the playbook, prove the channel works, then hand a mature operation over to the broader team

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

• TikTok scale-up. Set TikTok as a native-first growth engine. Own account architecture, bidding, audience strategy, and the creative cadence the platform demands. Partner with TikTok directly — joint steering committee, beta access, TTCX program, Managed Services — to unlock funding and capability gaps.

• TikTok creative strategy. The single biggest lever on TikTok is platform-native creative. Define the briefing approach with the Creative Strategist and Influencer team, scale Spark Ads and creator partnerships, and build the iteration cadence the 2–3 day fatigue window requires. Push the team away from "repurposed Reels" toward TikTok-first concepts.

• Pinterest and Snap pilots. Run structured launch playbooks for each: signal infrastructure (CAPI, pixel, EMQ), account setup, creative strategy fit-for-platform, market selection, and a clean incrementality test (CLS or geo) before we commit a real budget. Same rigor for Reddit if/when it earns its slot.

• Incrementality and effectiveness. Design and run the conversion lift / geo experiments that determine which channels stay, scale, or sunset. Calibrate MMM with each result.

• Channel-by-channel measurement. Own the data foundation across emerging channels — overlap analysis with Meta, audience cannibalization, true incremental CAC. Build the case (or the kill memo) with evidence, not platform-reported numbers.

• Future-channel scouting. Stay ahead on what's next — Reddit, ChatGPT/Copilot Ads, retail media, emerging short-video platforms. Maintain a prioritized backlog and a clear bar for what earns a pilot slot.

• Handover and scaling. Once a channel is proven and operationalized, transition BAU execution to the broader paid social team with documented playbooks, while staying accountable for the next bet.

What you’ll bring

• 5+ years in paid social or performance marketing, with deep hands-on TikTok Ads Manager fluency at a high-spend D2C, subscription, or e-commerce business. You've personally scaled a TikTok account from low single-digit % of spend into a meaningful contributor.

• Working knowledge of Pinterest Ads Manager and Snap Ads Manager — or a credible track record of taking a new platform from zero to scale, fast.

• Strong incrementality and experimentation muscle — you can design a CLS or geo test, defend the methodology, and read the result without spinning it.

• Sharp creative instinct for short-form video and platform-native content. You know why a TikTok hook is different from a Reels hook, and can brief and review against that.

• Comfortable building from scratch — pixel setup, account architecture, partner relationships, internal stakeholder buy-in. This role has more zero-to-one work than steady-state.

What we offer

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing

• You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.

• Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.

• Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.

Health & Wellbeing

• Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.

• Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.

Flexibility & Work-Life

• Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.

• Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.

• Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.

Career & Development

• Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.

Culture & Environment

• Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.

• We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.

Based in Auckland, New Zealand, the Marketing Manager will report to the Associate Director Brand for Meal Kits ANZ, working as part of a team that is responsible for bringing the HelloFresh brand strategy and go-to-market plan to life in fresh, creative ways in New Zealand. Excitingly, frequent travel to Australia is required as part of this role, to work closely with our Sydney team. This is a full-time, permanent role, starting from Oct 1 2026.

You will…

• Contribute to the development and hands-on execution of HelloFresh New Zealand marketing plans, becoming an expert on the local consumer, media, and food category landscape while balancing global stakeholder requirements.

• Contribute to an integrated brand calendar, working with local/global creative, brand, and product teams while integrating campaigns across marketing channels (SEO, influencer, paid social, direct sales, etc.) to drive wider goals.

• Deliver post-campaign analysis and reports, sharing the impact of marketing activity on business and brand KPIs alongside recommendations and hypotheses to test for future brand activity.

You have/are…

• Passionate about food and the HelloFresh brand, immensely curious about future possibilities, and driven to bring an innovative, ambitious approach to brand marketing.

• Extensive marketing knowledge (ideally brand/digital), with a solid understanding of tailoring cross-channel communication to increase brand salience, love, and consideration while balancing data to inform planning and decision making.

The role

We are looking for a Senior CRM Manager - Transformation to make CRM Self-Service at HelloFresh a reality.

Our central Growth function has a clear vision: Enabling our local marketing and product teams to reach our customers directly, via push notifications, in-app messaging and emails. For this to work in an efficient and customer-centric way, the right guardrails, tools and knowledge need to be in place.

Your first mission is to design, launch and scale our CRM self-service model. title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
description:
The role

As a Senior Marketing Data Analyst on our Pricing Analytics team within the Global Marketing Analytics organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader Market Insights work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.

What You'll Do

• Own price and discount experiments end to end — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.

• Model how customers respond to price and promotions — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.

• Apply causal inference — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.

• Ship analysis as data products — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.

• Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.

• Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.

• Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.

• Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.

• As scope grows, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

• A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.

• 4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.

• Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.

• A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.

• Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.

• Solid applied statistics, and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.

• A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
HelloFresh Ireland is in an exciting growth phase - expanding customer choice, deepening menu relevance, and driving long-term loyalty in a fast-growing market. As our Senior Product Manager, you will own the product space, driving impact across product strategy, product operations, and culinary workstreams. You will lead a talented, dedicated team and serve as the strategic engine behind what makes our boxes brilliant for Irish customers.

This is not a technology product role. You will work across the full physical product value chain and lifecycle - from ingredient sourcing and culinary development through to menu strategy, editorial execution, and customer experience - making decisions that directly impact what lands on our customers' doorsteps every week. You will need the ability to operate at pace, cut through complexity, and bring teams and stakeholders with you.

What You Will Be Doing:

• Strategic business planning: Reviewing product KPIs and guiding the team to improve the product offering - balancing short-term operations with long-term strategic direction, and owning the product investment calendar to increase retention while optimising for revenue and costs.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborating and building strong relationships with Operations, Marketing, and international teams - being the voice of the physical product for HelloFresh Ireland, advising on coherent processes between functions, and ensuring a coordinated approach to product initiatives across local and global stakeholders.

• Process optimisation: Identifying opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve how we work - across teams and with key partners - and aligning operational improvements with the strategic direction.

• Analytical decision making: Working with the team to ensure access to the relevant information, analyses, and insights needed to make informed product development decisions and translate the product vision into action.

• Business case development: Developing business cases around physical product improvements and product-related processes (e.g. changes in product offering, tooling, and automations), and making data-led recommendations to Ireland and global teams.

• People management: Leading, developing and inspiring teams spanning Culinary, Physical Product Strategy, and Product Operations - setting clear strategic direction, cultivating a high-performing culture, and supporting each team member's growth across different career stages.

Who You Are:

• Senior experience in product, category, or commercial - ideally food, FMCG, meal kits, or subscription.

• A genuine passion for food, with the ability to translate taste trends and market signals into compelling product offerings.

• Proven people leadership across different career stages - coaching, clear direction, and investment in growth.

• Strong commercial acumen - connecting product decisions to business outcomes including revenue and retention.

• Excellent cross-functional influence - aligning teams toward a shared goal without needing formal authority.

• Organised and structured, with strong project management skills and the ability to deliver to tight deadlines.

• Strong analytical skills - able to drill into detail, connect findings to the big picture, and present insights clearly.

• Customer-centric, with creative thinking to identify unmet needs and develop solutions that address them.

• A bias for action - moving quickly without sacrificing quality, bringing momentum to the teams around you.

• Sharp problem-solving instincts - comfortable with ambiguity and confident driving toward solutions.

• At home in lean, agile environments - able to do more with less and build from the ground up.

• Comfortable in Excel and Google Suite.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you will get in return:

• The chance to have a serious impact on one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Europe in an exciting growth phase

• Direct, high impact on our Operations setup from day one

• A vibrant, international environment with mission-driven colleagues

• A guaranteed steep learning curve & boost for your career

• Benefit from our selection of employee perks (70% off your HelloFresh boxes, private health insurance, employer matching pension program, cycle to work scheme, Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme, gym membership etc.)

Location: Dublin Docklands, Ireland

To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in ROI, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

Hybrid Working Policy
We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.

Next steps: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.

You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process criminal and background checks to the successful individual. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company.

 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.



Your main goal will be to empower n8n enterprise users to treat automation as software, enabling them to develop, deploy, and scale mission-critical workflows with absolute confidence.



To do so, you’ll own product strategy and execution for n8n’s Enterprise team, focused on application lifecycle management, developer tools, and production-grade workflow operations:




WORKFLOW LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT

 - Define how teams move workflows from development to production with clear environment separation and promotion paths.

 - Shape capabilities for workflow version history, rollback, branching, and conflict resolution.

 - Build product experiences that help engineering teams safely manage changes across mission-critical automations.
   
   


ENTERPRISE DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE

 - Own Git-based source control workflows that make n8n fit naturally into modern software development practices.

 - Work closely with Engineering and Design to deliver powerful yet intuitive tools for technical teams.

 - Translate complex developer workflows into product experiences that feel reliable, scalable, and easy to adopt.
   
   


PRODUCTION OPERATIONS AND OBSERVABILITY

 - Build visibility into workflow performance, usage, and reliability across environments and instances.

 - Define how enterprise teams manage external secrets, variables, and configuration across deployments.

 - Help customers operate n8n at scale through multi-instance management and cross-instance visibility.
   
   


PRODUCT DISCOVERY AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP

 - Deeply engage with enterprise customers, engineering leaders, admins, and developers to understand their software delivery needs.

 - Prioritize ruthlessly across technical depth, usability, enterprise readiness, and long-term platform leverage.

 - Align Engineering, Design, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership through clear strategy, specs, and communication.
   
   


REQUIREMENTS




MUST-HAVES

 - Proven product management experience: You’ve shipped complex technical products in enterprise environments and can point to lessons learned that shaped your craft.

 - Strong developer empathy: You understand how engineering teams build, test, version, deploy, and operate software in production.

 - Thrive in ambiguity: You bring structure to fuzzy technical problems and prioritize clearly across many possible directions.

 - Exceptional product sense: You anticipate edge cases, second-order effects, and enterprise-grade reliability needs without needing perfect information.

 - Ownership and bias for action: You fix what’s broken, ship, learn, and iterate rather than over-plan.

 - Influence without authority: You align engineering, design, data, sales, solutions engineering, customer success, and docs through clarity and trust.

 - Technical product judgment: You’re comfortable making tradeoffs across usability, scalability, security, reliability, and implementation complexity.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Git and source control experience: You’ve worked on or closely with products involving Git, branching, versioning, pull requests, or conflict resolution.

 - Enterprise security experience: You understand secrets management, environment variables, access control, or secure configuration patterns.

 - Observability experience: You’ve worked on products involving monitoring, usage insights, performance visibility, or operational dashboards.

 - Coding or SQL skills: You can code, write SQL, or go deep enough technically to partner effectively with engineers on architecture-level discussions.

 - Remote work experience: You’re familiar with remote-first work environments and can collaborate effectively across time zones.

 - Entrepreneurial or early-stage experience: You’ve worn many hats and can navigate in many areas at once.



Why join us?

At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll shape how engineering teams build, version, deploy, and operate mission-critical automations at scale — turning n8n into the platform where automation is treated with the same rigor as software. You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first team with high autonomy, strong technical ambition, and direct visibility into enterprise customer impact.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.



n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Your mission: drive ARR growth by turning hundreds (soon thousands) of n8n agency partners into a demand engine through scaled marketing programs.

Our agency partner network includes automation specialists and small consultancies with most ranging from 1–50 people. They leverage n8n to help their customers automate and transform their business - they have technical skills and customer knowledge but most have limited marketing resources.

The goal for this position is to define, build and launch creative marketing programs that our agency partners can utilize to grow their business with n8n. This will include building scalable self-serve programs (one to many) as well as working with some of the larger agency partners on specific marketing programs (one to one). Here’s an overview of what this position will be responsible for: 

Build the program portfolio - Drive adoption

 - Work directly with the agency partner marketing managers to define the overall strategy - what playbooks, what investments, what markets etc.

 - Ship ready-to-run programs: Event-in-a-Box kits for local workshops and seminars, email and social campaigns, industry-specific use-case campaigns, reusable customer stories and simple demand-gen playbooks.

 - Make every program executable without help: clear steps, editable templates and localisable assets that work for a solo consultant and a 50-person agency, in any region.

 - Drive awareness and adoption of the various marketing programs through scaled and creative communications.

Measure and multiply

 - Track the full funnel from access to download, execution, customer opportunities and revenue — for partners and for n8n.

 - Use partner feedback and performance data to decide what to scale, what to change and what to stop.

 - Turn each working program into a repeatable model for the next one, and automate your own program operations with n8n where it saves time.

 - Measure the overall business impact and growth from agency partner generated business.
   
   

Requirements 

Must-have

 - Partner marketing at scale: You've built one-to-many programs adopted by hundreds or thousands of partners, and can show adoption numbers

 - Self-service program design: You've packaged marketing so non-marketers can run it (kits, templates, playbooks) and know what makes them get used rather than downloaded

 - Small-business empathy: You understand how small consultancies work and design for their limited time, budget and marketing know-how

 - Outcome-driven measurement: You measure execution and pipeline, not asset views, and you're comfortable stopping a program that isn't working

 - Bias for action: You're happy as a first hire with limited design and development support; you ship a pilot quickly and improve it with real data

 - Global mindset: You've run programs across several regions and segments, and know how to localise without rebuilding from scratch

 

Nice-to-have

 - Strategic partner programs: You've also built custom marketing programs with large partners that ran over several months or quarters

 - Channel or ecosystem background: You've worked on an agency, solutions-partner or reseller program at a software company

 - Hands-on with automation: You've built workflows yourself — in n8n or similar tools — and can talk shop with technical partners

 - Local events: You've designed field events or workshops that others delivered

 - Secure the people, budget and commitments needed on both sides, then keep programs moving from plan to execution across complex partner organisations

 - Work with Sales on partner lead management and follow-up, and with Field Marketing, Demand Gen, Product Marketing and DevRel on joint go-to-market programs

Extend reach to Tier 2 and emerging-market partners

 - Build co-marketing programs with Tier 2 and regional partners, including in markets such as APAC where partners are our main route in

 - Adapt what works with strategic partners into lighter-weight programs that need less of our time

 - Turn your best programs into repeatable playbooks for every new strategic partner

title: Lead Professional, Brand Marketing, Football, France
description:
Are you ready to help shape the future of Nike Football in France?
 
As Lead Professional Brand Marketing, Football, you'll play a pivotal role in driving Nike’s football brand strategy across France, with a strong focus on Paris and Marseille.
 
Based in Paris, you'll join the France Country Marketing team, where sport, culture, and community intersect. Your role will bring Nike’s football vision to life through strategic campaigns, powerful storytelling, and locally relevant activations that connect authentically with athletes, consumers, and cultural leaders.
 
You'll adapt global and EMEA campaigns for maximum impact in one of the world’s most influential football markets, ensuring Nike remains at the centre of the game and the culture that surrounds it.
 
As part of your role, you'll also own the marketing relationship for some of Nike’s most high-profile football partnerships, helping to amplify the brand through athletes, clubs, and key moments that inspire the next generation.
 
WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH
 
In this role, you'll be part of the broader Football Brand team and collaborate closely with functional partners across Sports Marketing, Brand Creative, Retail Marketing, Communications, Energy Marketing, and Social & Community Impact.
You'll work in close partnership with the EMEA Football team and, at times, the Global Football team to ensure consistency, alignment, and impact across the marketplace. You'll also build strong relationships with external partners across the French football ecosystem, including athletes, clubs, federations, and retail accounts.
 
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 
You're a forward-thinking brand marketer with a deep passion for football and a strong understanding of the French football landscape. You know how to transform consumer insights into culturally relevant ideas and compelling storytelling that drives brand connection and business impact.
 
You thrive in collaborative environments, bring energy to every project, and are comfortable navigating complexity while influencing diverse stakeholders.
 
You'll bring:

• A proven track record in brand marketing roles requiring strong cross-functional collaboration.

• Experience in football marketing, with a deep understanding of the French football consumer and cultural landscape.

• Experience working with professional athletes, clubs, or federations, with the ability to build and manage relationships effectively.

• Familiarity with the French football retail environment and experience collaborating with retail partners.

• Demonstrated success leading projects and aligning internal and external teams behind a common vision.

• A strong connection to football culture and an understanding of its influence both on and off the pitch.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive, adaptable mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
 
Reporting to the Director, Brand Marketing Football, France, you'll be responsible for delivering Nike Football’s brand impact across the country.
 
You'll lead the planning and execution of seasonal brand campaigns, from strategic development through to marketplace activation. You'll bring energy, creativity, and precision to product launches, major football moments, and initiatives that keep Nike at the forefront of football culture in France.
 
Your work will connect Nike’s global football vision with local consumer insights, creating experiences and stories that are authentic, meaningful, and culturally relevant. You'll drive cross-functional alignment, cultivate strategic partnerships, and ensure every execution reflects the voice of the French football consumer while staying true to Nike's broader brand direction.
 
Through your leadership, you'll help shape how Nike shows up across football in France, building deeper connections with athletes and fans while driving brand distinction in one of Nike’s most important football markets.

Applications will be accepted until 6th November. We encourage external candidates to apply as soon as possible, as the posting may close earlier if we receive a sufficient number of applications.

title: Retail Brand Marketing Specialist II, France
description:
Retail Brand Marketing Specialist II, France

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a passionate, creative and consumer-obsessed retail brand marketer to help shape how Nike shows up across its Nike Direct marketplace in France.

You are energised by the intersection of sport, culture, community and retail, and understand how to translate brand strategies into locally relevant consumer experiences. You bring curiosity, agility and a growth mindset, thriving in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve across sport dimensions, including Football, Sportswear, Running, Training and beyond.

You have a deep understanding of Nike’s Young Athlete consumer, as well as the local communities and subcultures that shape and influence them. You are able to gather, connect and consolidate consumer, cultural, sport and marketplace insights, translating them into meaningful recommendations and local plans that build emotional connection with the next generation while creating distinction for Nike across sport.
 
Who You Will Work With

Based in Paris, you will be part of the wider France Integrated Retail Marketing team and report directly to the Retail Brand Manager, Nike Direct France.
You will work closely with cross-functional partners across the France territory and EMEA, including:

• Integrated Retail Marketing, including Retail Brand Wholesale

• Visual Merchandising & Styling

• EKIN, Nike’s product experts

• Brand Marketing

• Communications

• Sports Marketing

• Energy

• Nike Direct and retail teams

You will also partner with EMEA Retail Brand and other relevant EMEA functions to ensure alignment with seasonal strategies, exchange best practices and bring locally relevant insights back into the wider organisation.
Your day-to-day work will vary significantly. You will need to collaborate fluidly across functions, adapt your approach to different stakeholders and remain open to diverse expertise and perspectives to unlock stronger, more integrated consumer experiences.
 
What You Will Work On

You will help bring Nike’s seasonal sport and brand priorities to life across Nike Direct stores in France, translating EMEA strategies into compelling, locally relevant retail experiences.

Working across sport categories, you will support and, when appropriate, lead retail brand initiatives rooted in innovation, product, athlete storytelling, sport and culture. You will help ensure that every consumer touchpoint reflects Nike’s brand standards while responding to the specific needs of the French marketplace, its cities, communities and Young Athlete consumer.

You will contribute to the full journey, from gathering insights and supporting seasonal planning to activation, execution and post-campaign learning, ensuring Nike shows up consistently and distinctively across the Nike Direct fleet.
 
Key Responsibilities

• Support the development of the Nike Direct France retail brand vision, connecting Nike’s brand and sport priorities with relevant marketplace and consumer opportunities.

• Contribute to seasonal planning across Nike Direct, translating key sport, product, innovation, athlete and cultural stories into clear retail priorities and consumer journeys.

• Work with agility across Football, Sportswear, Running, Training and other sport dimensions according to seasonal priorities and business needs.

• Support and, when appropriate, lead the activation of seasonal campaigns, key sporting moments, athlete stories and locally relevant cultural opportunities across Nike Direct stores.

• Adapt EMEA strategies to the French marketplace, ensuring plans are locally relevant while remaining aligned with Nike’s wider brand direction.

• Gather, connect and consolidate consumer, community, cultural, sport and retail insights to identify opportunities and inform local plans.

• Develop a deep understanding of the Young Athlete consumer and of the communities, subcultures and influences shaping the next generation in France.

• Partner closely with Visual Merchandising & Styling and EKIN teams to translate seasonal strategies into impactful and educational retail experiences.

• Collaborate with Retail Brand Wholesale, Brand Marketing, Communications, Sports Marketing and Energy to deliver cohesive and integrated consumer experiences.

• Champion Nike’s brand standards across consumer touchpoints, ensuring premium, consistent and consumer-led execution from pinnacle experiences to fleet-wide scale.

• Coordinate retail brand programmes and contribute to effective project delivery across multiple stakeholders, priorities and timelines.

• Use campaign results, consumer feedback and marketplace learnings to identify opportunities to improve future planning and execution.

• Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing team culture, bringing curiosity, creativity, accountability and a solutions-oriented mindset.

What You Will Bring

• Relevant experience in brand marketing, retail marketing or another consumer-facing marketing role.

• Experience contributing to the planning and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, ideally within retail or an omnichannel environment.

• A strong understanding of the French consumer and retail landscape, with particular knowledge of the 15–25-year-old Young Athlete consumer.

• A deep curiosity for local communities and subcultures, and for the sporting and cultural forces that influence and shape the next generation.

• The ability to gather, analyse and consolidate consumer, cultural and marketplace insights, then translate them into clear recommendations and locally relevant marketing plans.

• An understanding of how brand stories come to life across physical and digital retail touchpoints.

• The ability to adapt EMEA or broader brand strategies to the specific needs of the French market without losing strategic consistency.

• The agility to move across different sport categories, consumer audiences and business priorities.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across territory and EMEA teams.

• Strong organisational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence and bring clarity to complex projects.

• A proactive, curious and solutions-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail and executional excellence.

• A genuine passion for sport, culture, retail and the Nike brand.

• Fluency in both French and English is required.

Please note, applications will close on the 6th November

Brand Creative is the Art of Storytelling. We are the storytellers. We are the voice of Nike’s heart & soul. It's about telling powerful, meaningful stories across the entire brand ecosystem, leveraging all existing and new platforms to inspire, enable and engage athletes*, while driving brand distinction and business impact. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
