About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for execution of change programs. We rely on our team's expertise and specialisms to engage with executive-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.

Salesforce is currently seeking a Data Cloud & Marketing Cloud Technical Architect to join our Professional Services team within the Customer Success Group (CSG). This role is centered on being a "Data" subject matter expert, leading the design and implementation of enterprise-grade Data Management solutions. While Data Cloud (Data 360) expertise is a must, the ideal candidate will also possess a strong background in Salesforce Marketing Cloud to drive cross-cloud success.

The Technical Architect is responsible for architecting scalable solutions across enterprise landscapes, ensuring data is democratized and ready for enterprise AI usage. You will work closely with Project Managers and Technical Architects to ensure on-time, fully functioning integrations. The ideal candidate thrives in an entrepreneurial atmosphere, communicates tactfully with business operations, and effectively designs, tests, and deploys complex software solutions. You must be an excellent communicator who can tailor delivery to a variety of audiences and communicate both in English and Italian fluently.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

• Become a Trusted SME: Act as the primary authority for Data Cloud to support project delivery, including how data architecture relates to the success of Agentforce and AI.

• Strategic Design: Drive the creation of application and technical design documents (Blueprints/FSD) which leverage Salesforce best practices and effectively integrate Salesforce into the customer's infrastructure.

• Data Democratization: Design and guide customer's enterprise data architecture, highlighting the importance of Data Governance and ensuring solutions adhere to security and privacy regulations.

• Technical Excellence: Provide guidance on integration development best practices, Enterprise Architecture standards, and environment management. Lead code reviews and define coding standards (SQL, SSJS, AMPScript).

• Stakeholder Management: Facilitate and influence Executive Customer stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI.

• Risk Mitigation: Troubleshoot key customer implementation issues and demonstrate the ability to drive to a successful resolution through proactive risk management.

You're Our Person If...

• Data Cloud Expertise: Direct experience designing and configuring the Data Cloud (Data 360) platform to enable enterprise use cases (Ingestion, Unified Profile, Insights, and Activation) or Marketing Cloud Mastery: 2+ years of direct experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio). Knowledge of AMPScript and SSJS is a strong plus.

• Minimum of 10 years' experience in professional services

• Architectural Proficiency: Deep knowledge in MDM, Data Distribution, and Data Modeling concepts, with a strong understanding of metadata and lineage.

• Solution Documentation: Ability to clearly and articulately document solutions, including data flows, engineering flowcharts, and technical artifacts.

• Requirement Translation: Ability to create a solution based on client requirements and map Business Processes into our technical product suite (e.g., mapping Data Cloud DMOs to Marketing Cloud Data Extensions).

• Cross-Cloud Integration: Knowledge of API patterns (REST/SOAP) and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CRM, Data Lakes).

• Technical Leadership: Lead inter-team meetings on technical and business challenges; conduct solutions testing and validation.

• Language Skills: Proficiency in English AND Italian languages is mandatory.

• Mobility: Travel to client sites for onsite discovery and solutions presentations (estimated 25% - 50%).

• Education: Degree or equivalent relevant experience required.

Even Better If...

• AI & Personalization: Familiarity with Agentforce Marketing and Marketing Cloud Personalization (formerly Interaction Studio).

• Strategic Communication: Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, able to present complex concepts at both tactical and executive levels.

• Data Background: 10+ years in data architecture or consulting, with a focus on relational data models and complex SQL syntax.

• Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with external Data Platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, GCP) and functional domains such as Finance, Telco, or Retail.

• Certifications: Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant, Salesforce Certified Data Architect, Marketing Cloud Email Specialist, and Marketing Cloud Consultant.

• Adaptability: Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, fluid environment and remain "scrappy" as we scale and evolve our team.

• Language: Any of the following languages: Polish, Greek, Hungarian or Czech is essential

Through our extended onboarding program of formal certification, internal training, knowledge transfer, hands-on experience and closely working with other Consultants, Architects and Project Managers you will become a Salesforce Domain Authority at the forefront of our offerings, delivering outstanding customer success.

Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Manager, B2B Marketing, Services
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Manager, B2B Marketing, Services

Overview: 
Mastercard’s Services Marketing team is seeking an experienced B2B Marketing Manager for Turkey, Eastern Europe and CIS division, and broader EEMEA region, including occasional travel to GCC and Africa. The person will be responsible for driving Mastercard Services marketing initiatives in the region. This role will align marketing strategies with regional product growth objectives to drive revenue generation and market development. 
 
As a B2B Marketing Manager, you will work with local and global marketing teams to generate demand for Mastercard’s solutions beyond cards – in the areas of Agentic Commerce, Data & Insights, Personalization, Loyalty, Business Experimentation, Fraud & Financial Crime, Advisory, Risk, Marketing Services, and Sponsorship Assets. Collaborating with the local and global marketing teams, product marketing, sales, and business development, you will work to develop and execute campaigns targeting mid- and bottom-funnel engagement. These campaigns will leverage a broad mix of marketing tactics including field marketing, digital, and content with the goal of driving leads to the local sales and account management teams. You will represent the regional and local marketing needs, back to the global marketing team, to facilitate understanding of what is needed to be successful in the market. 
 
This role requires a person who can be both collaborative with other teams, while at the same time driving marketing initiatives forward to completion with operational excellence. You will need to manage multiple projects and balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. We value the ability to grow together, move fast, and create value for our customers and stakeholders. 

Role: 
• Execute marketing campaigns on behalf of Mastercard Services. 
• Coordinate and partner with the country and regional business owners, marketing teams, and sales teams on joint demand generation initiatives that drive ROI. 
• Plan and manage regional hosted customer and partner facing events, trade shows, and other in-person marketing activations to enhance brand awareness and generate leads. 
• Design and execute email nurture, social media, and content syndication campaigns to support Mastercard thought leadership distribution and lead generation across various digital channels 
• Collaborate with Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Business Development leads to execute joint campaigns. 
• Work closely with sales teams to optimize the marketing/sales lead handoff to ensure lead handling SLAs (service level agreements) are being met. 

All About You: 
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in B2B marketing, performing in marketing for a portfolio of successful customer acquisition programs using field, digital and content marketing tactics. 
• Event organization experience and familiarity with event management best practices is required. 
• Experience in email & digital marketing is preferred. 
• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. Fluency in Turkish. 
• Record of successfully working in matrix marketing organizations. 
• Detail-oriented, well organized, and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment. 
• Self-directed and creative thinker; ready to proactively bring innovative ideas to the table, solve problems and take risks, to find new and innovative ways to improve results. 
• CRM (Customer Relationship Management) experience; Salesforce.com preferred. 
• Confident AI usage for copywriting, presentations creation, and data analysis. 
• Familiarity with HTML 
• Ability to travel up to 15% of the time.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

• Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

• Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

• Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

• Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Influencer and Community Brand Manager
description:
Job Location
LISBON GENERAL OFFICE
Job Description
Passionate about growing brands through creators, culture, and conversation? Join us as we take this capability to the next level at P&G. 
 
We’re building a new Influencer & Community team within our Brand organisation — and you’ll be at the heart of it, playing a central role in how our brands come to life through creator partnerships, relevant content and real consumer conversations across Portugal. 
 
Overview of the role: 
 
As Influencer & Community Manager you’ll own end-to-end influencer partnerships, strategy and execution — from insight generation and talent selection to content delivery and performance optimisation — driving brand relevance, trust, and measurable impact across P&G’s portfolio. 
 
Alongside this, you will also ensure these creator-led moments continue to live beyond campaigns, contributing to ongoing conversation, advocacy, and community engagement across platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Reddit. 
 
Working closely with Brand, Media, and PR teams, you’ll bring global strategies to life in a way that is locally relevant, culturally sharp, and built to perform. You’ll also help shape how we use cutting-edge tools and AI to unlock the next generation of brand building. 
 
This is a hands-on role for someone who understands creator culture, platform dynamics and how to turn content and conversation into growth. 
 
What You’ll Do 
 
Influencer & Creator Strategy & Execution 

• Lead locally relevant execution of influencer, KOL, and expert strategies, in line with regional guidance 

• Identify, vet and onboard creators across tiers (micro, macro, celebrity, experts) 

• Build and manage relationships with creators, agents, and talent partners 

• Own campaign delivery end-to-end: briefing, content, rollout, budget management with ROI focus, performance analysis and optimisation 

Community Engagement & Advocacy 

• Engage with audiences across key platforms, bringing campaigns to life through real-time conversation and turn creator content into ongoing engagement and advocacy 

• Monitor sentiment, manage risks and escalate issues where required 

• Develop and maintain community guidelines, response frameworks, and escalation protocols 

• Drive UGC and advocacy programmes, encouraging participation and amplifying consumer voices 

Content & Social Ecosystem Integration 

• Collaborate with Brand and Creative teams to shape social-first content strategies and calendars, ensuring influencer, UGC, and brand content work together as a connected ecosystem 

• Identify high-performing content for cross-channel amplification (organic + paid) 

• Contribute to development of authentic, platform-native content formats and support creation of low-fi, socially native reactive content where needed 

Social Listening, Trends & Insights

• Monitor social conversations, trends, and competitor activity 

• Leverage social listening and AI tools (e.g., internal tools, platform dashboards) to generate insights 

• Translate insights into actionable recommendations for content, creators, and campaigns and share learnings and best practices across local and regional teams 

Governance, Compliance & Best Practices 

• Ensure all content and partnerships align with brand guidelines, platform best practices, and Portugal advertising regulations 

• Provide guidance to internal teams and creators on disclosure and compliance standards 

What we offer you: 

• Competitive salary + flexible benefits. 

• Employee stock ownership and savings plan with company contributions. 

• Health insurance and life insurance. 

• 22 vacation days. 

• Relocation support if needed. 

• Continuous learning and development opportunities. 

• Meaningful work from Day 1: The opportunity to work with some of the world’s most recognized consumer brands and help shape how they connect with the next generation of consumers. 

• This role is based in our Portugal Head Office in Lisbon. 

Job Qualifications
What you’ll bring 

• Experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or social media. Exposure to health/beauty, or consumer brands is an advantage 

• Portuguese and English mandatory are mandatory.

• Proven record of managing end-to-end influencer campaigns, from briefing through to reporting 

• Strong understanding of Portugal creator landscape and platform dynamics 

• Ability to connect creator storytelling with broader brand engagement 

• Data-driven mindset, with the ability to analyze performance and optimize campaigns 

• Experience managing budgets and delivering measurable results (engagement, awareness, conversion) 

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution 

• Strong communication and collaboration skills in fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environments 

• Genuine enthusiasm for the Consumer Goods industry, staying updated on trends and emerging creators, products and brands.

title: Sr Marketing Director, DACH
description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a commercially minded marketing leader to serve as Sr Director, Marketing for the DACH region. This role will lead the Germany, Austria, and Switzerland marketing agenda, owning end-to-end market planning, budget allocation, campaign strategy, partner marketing, and execution across a highly matrixed, two-sided network. 

The role will translate global strategies into locally relevant market plans while ensuring DACH insights inform global priorities. The successful candidate will work closely with corporate, global, and North America leadership, as well as regional Sales, Product, Finance, Analytics, Partnerships, and Marketing teams. 

This is not a traditional brand marketing role. It is a commercially focused leadership position accountable for driving measurable business growth, optimizing marketing investment, and strengthening the consumer and merchant flywheel across the PayPal ecosystem.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities: 

• Develop and articulate a clear, compelling vision and strategy for the marketing function

• Provide key inputs as an industry leader and expert in marketing

• Inspire and lead the marketing team to achieve long-term success

• Align marketing strategies with PayPal-wide strategy and operations

• Drive innovation and continuous improvement in marketing practices

• Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure the marketing function supports overall business goals

Minimum Qualifications:

• 12+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Essential Responsibilities: 

• Establish and execute the overall marketing strategy for the organization

• Influence executive-level decision-making on marketing initiatives

• Collaborate with executive leadership to align marketing strategies with business objectives

• Lead large-scale marketing projects and programs with significant impact

• Analyze market trends and competitive landscape to inform strategic decisions

• Provide strategic guidance and mentorship to marketing team leaders

As Sr Director, Integrated Marketing, you will be accountable for connecting marketing strategy and execution to commercial outcomes. You will: 

• 
• Lead the strategic development and execution of the DACH market plan. 

• Own end-to-end planning across priorities, investments, campaigns, partners, and performance. 

• Drive market share growth, customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and conversion. 

• Apply a deep understanding of two-sided network businesses and consumer fintech to identify growth opportunities across consumers, merchants, partners, and platforms. 

• Use flywheel economics to evaluate how marketing investments can create value across both sides of the network. 

• Manage the DACH marketing portfolio, prioritizing initiatives and allocating resources toward the highest-value opportunities. 

• Establish clear measurement frameworks and optimize marketing return on investment. 

• Serve as a senior member of the German country leadership team. 

• Build alignment across corporate, global, North America, and DACH stakeholders. 

• Lead and develop the DACH Consumer Marketing team. 

Your Day-to-Day 

• 
• 
• Develop annual and quarterly integrated market plans aligned to business priorities and global strategy. 

• Translate global strategies into relevant local execution, balancing enterprise consistency with DACH market needs. 

• Manage budget allocation, forecasting, investment prioritization, and performance reviews. 

• Lead integrated campaigns across the full customer funnel, from demand creation through acquisition, engagement, and conversion. 

• Develop customer and partner marketing strategies that drive measurable commercial growth. 

• Partner closely with Sales to develop co-marketing initiatives, support priority opportunities, and strengthen partner value propositions.

title: Growth Marketing Lead, Paris
description:
Description
Join the team empowering the world to design
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, こんにちは, 你好, hallo, नमस्ते, 안녕하세요, hola, salut!
At Canva, our mission is to empower the world to design—and we’re growing fast across the globe. With over 250 million monthly active users in over 190 countries, we’re on a mission to make Canva the most loved brand in the world. To support this ambition, we’re building a world-class growth marketing team that’s deeply local, highly creative, and relentlessly performance-focused.
We're looking for a Performance Marketing Specialist to join our team in France, focused on driving incremental user growth through great investment decisions, media buying strategy and execution, supporting creative and ensuring we send traffic to great post-click experiences.
About the role
As the Performance Marketing Specialist for France, you will be the analytical media expert that partners closely with our creative strategist and broader marketing team in France to drive great incremental returns on our media investments.
To be successful in this role you will need to understand the modern media measurement toolkit, media buying principles in key channels, what makes creative great in key channels and iteratively improve our funnel experiences.
As part of this role, you will work collaboratively with the rest of the marketing team focused on brand campaigns, lifecycle and partnerships for example. You will also help raise the bar in full funnel media management. 
What you'll do

• Own day to day media buying, optimisation and pacing across multiple channels in France. You will focus on creative-led channels ( Meta, YT & TT, LinkedIn) as we have global search and ASO teams supporting France

• Translate France priorities into concrete strategy and plans. Set these in partnership with the Global Growth Marketing team and France Country Team.

• Set the media mix, lead budget allocation review processes and own the experiment roadmap.

• Partner with the Data team to run incrementality studies, interpret and calibrate our MMMs, utilise MMP and platform form data where appropriate.

• Translate performance data into clear creative insights, sharing learnings with Growth Creative pods that prioritise native vertical video and creator partnerships with embedded Growth Marketers.

• Actively manage creative rotation: scale top-performing assets, pause low performers, and proactively flag refresh needs that shape our creative strategy.

• Evaluate audience segmentation, targeting, and bidding strategies, proposing improvements and experiments across the region.

• Work closely with creative team to maximise Tiktok Content Suite and champion best practices in modern content formats to get and retain attention.

• Level up creative cohort analysis and bring unique insights into how we are running our creative flywheel.

• Lead formulation, implementation and learning cycles through CRO initatives across channels.

• Improve performance marketing systems and workflows, with a focus on automation, adopting AI tooling and even building reusable systems

You’re probably a match if you have:

• Proven hands-on experience in media buying and budget management across major platforms with strong media buying principle understanding.

• Strong optimisation mindset and confidence making data-driven decisions.

• Proven experience collaborating with creative teams to improve performance through structured testing and iteration.

• Cross-channel growth mindset, able to evaluate trade-offs, dynamically shift investment, and prioritise incremental impact.

• Familiarity with MMM, lift studies, and incrementality testing. Design experiments autonomously and build a strong relationship with the Marketing Science team.

title: Creative Strategist, Growth Marketing, Netherlands (12-Month Contract)
description:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design
Hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
Where and How You Can Work

This role is based in Amsterdam, with a hybrid working arrangement. Our Amsterdam hub is a place for collaboration and creative energy and we want you close enough to the Dutch market to genuinely feel it. You'll have the flexibility to work in a way that suits you, with meaningful time in the office to connect with the team.
About the Role

As the Creative Strategist for Netherlands, you'll be the creative performance engine behind Canva's paid and organic marketing in the region — working at the intersection of data, storytelling, and cultural nuance to drive real user growth. This is a hands-on, insight-led role where local knowledge, analytical curiosity, and creative excellence drive outcomes. You won't manage a direct team, but you'll have real influence — over creative direction, agency partners, and the cross-functional teams who help bring ideas to life.
What You'll Do

• Lead the creative flywheel — own the full creative cycle (research, briefing, production, editing, and analysis), driving sprint cycles with regional and global teams and developing testable ideas grounded in user insights

• Analyse and optimise performance — dig into dashboards to spot winners, diagnose underperformance, and design creative tests, lift studies, and attribution experiments in close partnership with analytics teams

• Lead organic and paid social creative strategy — define what high-performing creative looks like for Dutch audiences across Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platforms, building content systems informed by performance data and local cultural moments

• Own UGC, localisation, and market insight — brief and review creator content to ensure it's on-brand and platform-optimised, and bring genuine cultural fluency to every project

• Work with in-house and agency teams — bridge external creative partners and internal stakeholders, working with media buyers, data science, the Europe Growth Marketing Lead, and agency partners across Brand, Product Growth, and Analytics

• Support conversion across the funnel — contribute to CRO initiatives to make acquisition journeys seamless, engaging, and high-converting

What We're Looking For

You bring real, hands-on experience in creative strategy or performance marketing and you know what it takes to build creative that actually performs. You understand platform-native formats deeply, you're rigorous about testing, and you use data to sharpen your thinking rather than replace it. You have genuine knowledge of the Dutch market — not surface-level familiarity — and you move comfortably between global teams, agency partners, and local execution. You're self-directed, collaborative, and you take ownership of outcomes.
You're Probably a Match If

• You have extensive experience in growth marketing with a focus on creative strategy across paid and organic social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram)

• You have a strong eye for platform-native creative and the frameworks to test, learn, and scale it

• You're confident using performance dashboards, data tools, and measurement frameworks (including MMM and attribution) to drive decisions

• You have genuine, deep knowledge of the Benelux market and are fluent in Dutch and English — additional languages are a bonus

• You have strong experience briefing and iterating creative in cross-functional sprints

• You have a growth mindset — analytical, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity

About the Group/Team

Our Europe Marketing Group drives market-specific growth across performance marketing, brand, social, community engagement, and more. We work at the intersection of creativity and data, combining global thinking with genuine local understanding to drive meaningful outcomes in our priority markets. We grow through experimentation, creative excellence, and a deep belief that getting the creative right is the fastest path to sustainable growth.
Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!
Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.
Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

title: Senior Retail Project Manager - Global Partnerships
description:
ID: JR0084293
The Mission
Are you ready to join an ambitious and rapidly growing company that is changing the retail industry? At Glovo, our vision is to give everyone easy access to anything in the city. As a Project Manager in the Global Retail Partnerships team, you will help make this vision a reality. You will build the performance tools, insights and project structure that our global and local teams rely on to grow our most strategic retail partnerships across multiple countries.
At Glovo, Retail is one of our fastest-growing business units. We have already established partnerships with more than 200 top retail brands, including industry leaders in the Beauty, Electronics and Pets verticals. You will join the Global Retail Partnerships team, which still has the spirit of a small startup within Glovo despite our rapid growth.
What You Will Do.

• Strategic Analysis & Insights

• Be the analytical engine behind our most strategic global partnership projects, including the Masterplan, Business Plan and Target Setting.

• Dig into partner and category performance to uncover the insights that shape our strategy.

• Deliver ad-hoc analyses for global partners and internal stakeholders, directly influencing how we grow our partnerships.

• Tools & Enablement

• Design and build the tools regional and local teams across multiple countries need to succeed. Examples include Partner Business Plan calculators, business plan models, migration trackers and operational spreadsheets.

• Own the Retail Bible and the Quick Commerce onboarding materials, our team’s go-to knowledge base. Keep them relevant and well organized, gather feedback on adoption, and continuously improve them so they become indispensable for local teams.

• Performance Management & Business Intelligence

• Own how the Global Retail team measures success. You will design, build and maintain the performance tracking tools we use to monitor progress against our goals.

• Turn data into direction by spotting opportunities and risks early, so the team can act on informed decisions rather than gut feeling

• Cross-Functional Project Management

• Drive cross-functional projects with Strategy, Operations, Product, Finance, Catalog & PIM, and Integrations, ensuring deliverables land on time and on scope.

• Build the tools that support key retail operations topics, such as uptime, cancellations, and others.

What You Will Bring

• Background: 3 to 5 years of experience in fast-paced environments, such as startups, consulting, leading internet companies, FMCG or retail. This should include experience in project management, business analysis, or a similar role.

• Analytical & Technical Skills: Advanced spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets/Excel) and experience with BI tools, SQL.

• Project Management: You can structure complex projects with independence, manage many stakeholders and priorities at once, and deliver against tight deadlines without direct authority.

• Tool-Building Mindset: You enjoy turning messy processes into simple, scalable tools, and you have experience building tools or dashboards that others rely on day to day.

• Business Understanding: A solid grasp of retail, FMCG and/or e-commerce models and what drives their revenue and growth.

• Bias for Action & Problem Solving: You are goal-oriented and detail-driven, and you take ownership from the first question to the final deliverable.

• Language Skills: Professional proficiency in English.

Individuals representing diverse profiles, and abilities, encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.
We believe driven talent deserves:

• 🌟 An enticing equity plan that lets you own a piece of the action.

• 💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.

• 🍔 Monthly Glovo meal benefit to satisfy your cravings!

• 💳 Cobee discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses or office-based nursery.

• 🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.

• 🏖️ The freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year and personal days off.

• 👪 Enhanced parental leave.

• 🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.

At Glovo, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.
Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.
Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).
So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our LinkedIn and website!

Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

title: (Senior) Product Manager - (Logistics, Customer Choice)
description:
Test fast. Learn faster. As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll own the demand management solutions that keep ordering smooth when delivery capacity is stretched. You’ll work hands-on with Engineering and Data Science to turn real-time fleet saturation signals into product decisions that lift peak-time conversion and reduce cancellations. You’re accountable for execution as much as strategy, bringing Operations, regional teams, and engineers along as features go live.
We are building the Choice products that decide which options customers see, balancing real-time fleet saturation with customer intent so logistical saturation doesn't get in the way of ordering. 
In our Logistics Team, you'll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.

• Own the roadmap for demand management solutions that balance fleet capacity with customer ordering.

• Take features from idea to launch with Engineering, writing clear requirements and prioritizing the backlog.

• Partner with Data Science to shape and evaluate models and AI-driven configurations that replace manual operational settings.

• Run experiments and track conversion, cancellation, and fleet saturation metrics to decide what ships next.

• Align Operations, regional product teams, and engineers on priorities, trade-offs, and timelines throughout delivery.

• Coordinate with multiple internal stakeholders to ensure the services we use are being consumed and to understand the end-to-end impact.

• Product management experience, ideally in marketplace, logistics, or e-commerce environments.

• A track record of managing stakeholders through execution and aligning diverse teams on complex initiatives.

• Hands-on ownership: you're comfortable working through details with engineers, including APIs and system behavior.

• Comfort using data to define success measures and assess impact.

• Experience working with data scientists, plus a working understanding of ML concepts and experimentation frameworks.

• Ability to manage several competing priorities when operational conditions change quickly.

Nice to have

• Experience in logistics, delivery, or other supply-and-demand balancing problems.

• Experience building internal tools for operations teams.

• Exposure to rules engines, ranking, or personalization systems.

• Experience launching AI-driven product features.

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

title: Senior Lawyer Commercial
description:
As an in-house lawyer here, the bare minimum expectation is that you will be drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts. But what we really care about is the impact of that work. When you draft an agreement, you aren't just pushing paper—you are unlocking a new strategic partnership, enabling a new feature on the App, or closing a deal that directly drives revenue. Your legal work literally translates into business milestones you can see on the streets and in the App. 
We are looking for a business enabler. The right candidate is someone who enjoys being embedded in the commercial team, understands the internal services dynamic, and can provide quick, actionable, and pragmatic legal advice. If you thrive in a fast-paced, international environment where you are a strategic partner to the business, you will succeed here.

• Solid background: You have a Degree in Law. A Master’s degree (e.g., Máster de Acceso a la Abogacía, LLM, or a specialized corporate/commercial master's) and admission to the Spanish Bar are highly valued

• Relevant experience: You bring 4 to 6 years of post-qualification experience, ideally gained through a mix of a top-tier law firm and an in-house legal department within a fast-paced, high-growth, or tech environment.

• Language fluency: Bilingual or highly proficient professional level in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) is mandatory, as you will draft and negotiate complex legal documents in both languages. Any other language is more than welcome! 

Technical capabilities:

• Contractual expertise: You have a proven track record of drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a high volume and wide variety of commercial agreements (e.g., partnerships, marketing, IT, procurement, and suppliers).

• You have experience drafting and updating Terms & Conditions for B2B and B2C models. Previous exposure to digital platforms, e-commerce, or tech sector is a significant plus.

• Broad legal knowledge: You possess a strong foundation in commercial and corporate law, with the versatility to navigate overlapping regulatory, IP, and platform issues.

• Knowledge: Possesses deep expertise in commercial law and a strong understanding of the broader organization, business model, and industry landscape.

• Scope: Performs a wide range of complex activities across multiple areas (e.g., handling cross-border agreements between Spain and HQ).

• Autonomy: Operates with high independence and autonomy. Not only proposes improvements but actively leads the implementation of new processes and legal frameworks.

• Problem-solving: Solves complex, ambiguous problems where guidelines may be unclear or non-existent, balancing legal risk with commercial business objectives.

• Impact: Leads cross-functional projects and initiatives (like the T&Cs overhaul) that directly impact broader company goals and multiple business units.

Mindset & Approach:

• High Autonomy & Judgment: You are a self-starter who can act as a reliable "go-to" person. You know how to prioritize tasks, resolve day-to-day issues independently, and apply sound, risk-balanced judgment.

• Strong Business Acumen: You don't just point out legal risks; you offer practical, business-oriented solutions that align with the company’s commercial objectives.

• Cross-Functional Team Player: You excel at stakeholder management and have a proven ability to collaborate seamlessly with non-legal teams across a diverse, multicultural organization.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Job Ref ID: JR0087979
YOUR MISSION
At Glovo, we are witnessing extraordinary growth in our Quick-commerce business, and we’re just getting started. As leaders in this space, we have a unique opportunity to increase online grocery penetration from 2-3% to over 10% in our markets.
As a Product Manager in our Quick-commerce team, you’ll play a crucial part in enhancing our core value propositions of affordability and assortment, while building customer trust through outstanding pre- and post-purchase experiences. Your challenge will be to develop innovative product features that address these opportunities and drive our growth forward.
THE JOURNEY

• Problem Solving: Utilize strong problem-solving skills to navigate challenges and devise effective solutions that drive product success.

• Critical Thinking: Apply critical thinking to assess complex situations, make informed decisions, and prioritize initiatives that maximize impact.

• Product Strategy: Define and drive the product vision and roadmap for our Quick-commerce offerings, aligning with overall business goals.

• Customer Insights: Conduct market research and gather customer feedback to identify pain points and opportunities for improvement.

• Feature Development: Lead the development of new product features, ensuring they enhance our core value propositions. Champion exceptional user experiences throughout the pre- and post-purchase journey, building customer trust and loyalty.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders to align on priorities, gather insights, and ensure successful product delivery.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, design, and data teams to deliver high-quality products on time.

• Performance Metrics: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and iterate based on data-driven insights.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

• Proven experience in product management, preferably in consumer facing products.

• Ability to thrive in a fast paced environment without excessive structure

• A strong business-driven mindset and product sense.

• Solid experience collaborating with technical stakeholders (Data, Engineering & Design).

• Strong analytical skills and experience with data-driven decision-making.

• Excellent communication skills to align a diverse set of stakeholders (both technical and non-technical), drive vision, and clearly explain user value and business impact.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Director of B2B Marketing, Retail Media - Vendor
description:
Bold voices. Big influence. As a Global Director of B2B Marketing, you'll turn Delivery Hero's first-party data into the story that brings CPG brands, media agencies and local merchants to our retail media network. You'll own the global B2B brand and demand engine across Glovo, Talabat, foodpanda and PedidosYa, and set the narrative for an advertising business that connects with millions of customers.
Join the team driving brand growth and customer engagement across our markets. As part of our Marketing Team, you'll help shape strategies that build customer loyalty and optimize the effectiveness of our marketing investments. With each campaign and initiative, you'll play a key role in creating connections with millions of customers, positioning Delivery Hero as a leader in the market.

• Define and own the global brand identity, narrative and go-to-market positioning for Delivery Hero's advertising business across our multi-brand portfolio (Glovo, Talabat, foodpanda, PedidosYa).

• Design integrated multi-channel campaigns (digital, account-based marketing, email, content) that generate qualified leads and drive inbound ad spend from enterprise CPGs and agency trading desks.

• Shape our presence at flagship industry events such as Cannes Lions, DMEXCO and Shoptalk, and run executive roundtables and agency roadshows in key media hubs like London.

• Partner with global and regional ad sales teams to create pitch decks, case studies, trade PR and research whitepapers that show closed-loop ROI and retail attribution.

• Align with the Product Marketing team to deliver one cohesive go-to-market strategy.

• Lead a central B2B marketing team and give regional ad teams in MENA, APAC, LATAM and Europe strategic direction and marketing toolkits.

• Significant B2B marketing leadership experience in AdTech, digital media, e-commerce or retail media networks.

• A track record of scaling an ad network or B2B brand globally, building demand generation funnels and managing sizable event and campaign budgets.

• Skill in turning complex AdTech concepts and first-party consumer data into clear, memorable commercial narratives and trade PR campaigns.

• Experience leading cross-functional teams in a global, multi-brand matrix organization.

• Strong executive presentation and written communication skills in English.

Nice to have

• Established relationships with CPG brands, media agencies or agency trading desks.

• Hands-on experience with account-based marketing and marketing automation tools.

• Experience marketing across several regions, such as MENA, APAC, LATAM and Europe.

• Working knowledge of retail attribution and measurement.

title: Head of Brands Ads Product Strategy & Operations HQ
description:
Job Ref ID: JR0085668
YOUR MISSION 
As the Head of Product Strategy & Operations for Brands Ads, you are the strategy and scaling engine behind Glovo's fastest-growing revenue stream. Your core challenge over the next 12-18 months is to anchor the Go-to-Market roadmap between Glovo and Delivery Hero, launch best-in-class ad placements globally, and define the automated tools and infrastructure required to optimize campaigns at scale.
THE JOURNEY

• Product Roadmap Influence: Anchor the GTM roadmap between Glovo and Delivery Hero Product teams. Identify gaps, prioritize local market needs with Local Heads, and launch 2+ new ad placements globally.

• Elite stakeholder management skills; capable of aligning Delivery Hero Product, Glovo Product, Data, and Local Heads in a highly matrixed environment.

• Proven ability to define operational tools and scalable processes for campaign optimization, paired with strong financial planning/modeling skills.

• Experience managing hybrid teams (direct and dotted-line reporting lines) to execute complex, cross-functional strategic goals.

title: Senior Brand Media Manager
description:
We are looking for a highly organized, analytical, and strategic Senior Brand Media Manager to join our Marketing team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving brand awareness and growth through an efficient, effective, and insight-led media strategy across 5 foodora markets (Austria, Czechia, Hungary, Norway, Sweden).
The successful candidate will lead and support the planning, buying, execution, and optimization of large-scale brand-building campaigns across traditional and digital media channels. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, including defining media and communication strategies, driving best practices across markets, and leveraging data and insights to continuously improve campaign performance and effectiveness.
You will work closely with local and central teams, agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure strong media planning and execution, while fostering consistency, innovation, and best practice across markets.
Your mission:

• Lead the global media planning and buying for foodora across all media channels (ATL, Online Branding, Influencers)

• Analyze performance, consolidate learnings and present results to key decision makers to help shape media strategy 

• Engage with local and regional Marketing teams to conduct deep dives & translate results into actionable recommendations

• Work closely with other internal departments and drive marketing strategy for our brands. This includes cross-functional projects on topics like creative & content strategy, campaigns, pricing, subscription models or cross-channel measurement

• You ideally have 6+ relevant experience in Marketing and/or Media Buying & Planning 

• Experience in FMCG, Tech and/or media agency is a big plus 

• You are analytical, logical thinking and have advanced knowledge ROI measurement 

• You are a strategic problem solver who can define and assess challenges, and communicate back to stakeholder in a clear and concise way

• You have high interest and experience in leading cross-functional projects

• Your self-organization keep you always on top of your tasks 

• You are a hands-on team player with good relationship building skills

• Excited to learn and try out new things

• Fluent in English, any other language is a plus

• Flexible working hours

• Home Office 2 x a week

• Competitive salary: your total compensation may include other benefits described above and equity and/or variable bonuses for pre-defined roles. 

• 5 weeks of vacation

• Flexible benefits which you can use for things like a MultiSport card, a cafeteria/benefits package, orders from Foodora, or for investments

• A wide range of inclusive and flexible benefits including paid leave for your child’s first day of kindergarten or school, birthday day, wedding, funeral, IVF treatment, and gender affirmation, as well as the option of full home office upon return from parental leave or before birth for partners of future mothers or adoptive parents (beyond statutory requirements)

• On-site massages and circuit training

• Free ice cream, unlimited fruit, and coffee

• Employee discounts on Alza, Smarty, O2 and others

• Advanto – the option to withdraw earned wages anytime during the month

title: Product Manager - Discover
description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely.


Your Mission
As the Product Manager for the Discover squad, you will focus on the upper funnel of the passenger journey. Your mission is to capture global traffic via SEO and emerging LLM-based search (GEO), ensuring passengers have a seamless experience when they land on our platform. You will build a vision that maximizes conversion from all acquisition channels, prioritizing high-impact projects across our core markets.
The Team
The Demand Team: The Discover squad is a core team of the Demand pillar, owning the end-to-end passenger experience alongside Search, Booking, Payment, and Post-booking.
Your Squad: You will co-lead the Discover squad alongside an Engineering Manager. The squad consists of 6 front-end engineers.
Internal Stakeholders: Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing Managers, Product Data, Product Design, and Business leads.


Your Responsibilities
• Shape the Discover strategy & roadmap: Define the Product and Engineering vision for the Discover scope, along with the appropriate KPIs to measure progress. You will take full responsibility for your scope from strategy to execution.

• Drive top-funnel acquisition: Partner with the Marketing and SEO teams to define and deliver the acquisition roadmap. This includes adapting our architecture for the AI era to ensure our inventory is easily crawlable by LLMs and AI agents.

• Maximize landing page conversion: Define and deliver a strategy to optimize the landing experience and maximize conversion from all channels. You will leverage AB tests to run experiments and drive our Land-to-Book conversion targets.

• Navigate cross-functional alignment: Act as the go-to product person for all Discover topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions, and ensure alignment across Engineering, Marketing, Design, Data, and Business teams.

• Manage the Busfor platform: Act as the referent Product Manager for Busfor, a standalone brand acquired and owned by BlaBlaCar operating in Eastern Europe

Your Qualifications
• Experience: 3+ years of Product Management. An experience in top-of-funnel acquisition, growth, or SEO is preferred but not required.

• Problem-Solving: Highly analytical with a proven track record of using A/B testing to deliver fast, incremental impact on conversion rates.

• Stakeholder Influence: Strong interpersonal skills to navigate cross-functional relationships, gain buy-in, and clearly communicate prioritization decisions.

• Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory.

If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!

What we have to offer
• 2 to 3 days at the office per week

• 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

• 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

• Financial support for home office equipment

• Minimum 25 days holiday per year

• Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

• 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

• Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like.
• A 45-min video-call with Talent Acquisition.

• A 45-minute video call with the Lead Product Manager.

• A Remote use case exercise, followed by a 45-minute presentation to a cross-functional panel of key stakeholders.

• A 30-minute video call with your engineering counterpart for final validation.

Our hiring process lasts on average 20-25 days and offers usually come within 48 hours.

BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
